newsitem.title: USA: CBS-TV upfront ad market edges higher.
newsitem.headline: CBS-TV upfront ad market edges higher.

text.p: Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS Television Network sold about $1.25 billion in upfront advertising for the fall primetime TV season, up about $100 million from last year, Joe Abruzzese, president of network TV sales, confirmed Wednesday.
Including sales during its coverage of the Nagano Winter Olympics next year, advertising sales totalled $1.81 billion, Abruzzese said.
He reported that the network's primetime ad rates rose about 11-12 percent.
Upfront sales in its daytime programming totalled about $400 million, little changed from last year, Abruzzese said, with ad rates increasing 11-12 percent.
